contract: One rule per cross-component domain, naming the exact records and facts it reasons over, its conditions, a conditioned refusal, and a verdict limited to NEEDS BENCH or UNSOURCED. Conditioned calculations recompute from raw fact values on every run. The domains listed in component-spec-audit/references/schema.json integration_domains must match this file exactly.

rules.conditions: Current chain: Board P nominal 15 V / 3 A -> AP63201 +13.44 V, LM2596 +6.519 V and -14.145 V intermediates -> LT1963A +12/+5 V and LT3015-12 -12 V. R5/R6 are 10.5 k/1 k 0.1%; tolerance/TCR/reference calculations are screening, with actual low-line dropout, ripple and thermal coupling open. Board A and original regulator facts are historical and are not current-stage proof.
rules.refusal: Do not certify regulated output or the 26.5 W rated total until all three outputs pass low-line, full-load, ripple and thermal tests with the programmed PD core.

conditioned_calculations.conditions: Typical reference and nominal precision-divider values; not a regulated-load measurement.

rules.conditions: SMAJ20A 32.4 V is a conditioned 12.3 A,10/1000 us table point, not a universal ceiling. It exceeds Q1 VDS and the retained controller maximum. Adding the nominal 14.145 V negative intermediate gives 46.545 V across U4/D3, exceeding 45 V/40 V limits. Output TVS standoff does not prove attached module protection or LDO output-pin fault tolerance.
rules.refusal: Do not call the protection chain qualified while source/gate/switch/rail surge waveforms and attached-load maximum ratings remain unmeasured or unsourced.

conditioned_calculations.conditions: Nominal negative setpoint plus conditioned TVS table point; actual transient duration and waveform unknown.

rules.conditions: U4 local GND/ON-OFF/tab ride the renewed negative intermediate. Effective input and D3 reverse stress are VBUS plus the negative magnitude. Nominal is 29.145 V; negative resistor/reference/TCR worst-cases, ringing and startup require separate screens. C9 remains the 50 V bridge capacitor.
rules.refusal: Do not infer surge or startup acceptance from normal DC margin; preserve the negative rail, floating ground and semiconductor stress calculations after every setpoint change.

conditioned_calculations.conditions: Typical-reference setpoint; scenario VBUS values are explicit screen inputs.
Capacitor DC stress screen; ripple and transient waveform not included.

rules.conditions: LT1963A replaces both positive regulators and LT3015-12 replaces the negative regulator. AP pre-rail arithmetic is 13.219794..13.6624 V with the selected resistor/TCR envelope. Negative minimum is 13.483572 V with full-temperature reference and 0.35% combined resistor tolerance/TCR, leaving 0.483572 V above the fixed-12 input guarantee boundary before ripple. LT1963A adjustment-bias maximum is only specified at 25C; do not extrapolate it as a full-temperature limit. Include load-dependent ground current in thermal screens and verify output capacitor ESR/effective capacitance.
rules.refusal: The new parts improve DC headroom, but mirror-source trust, full-temperature adjustment bias, actual low-line ripple, capacitor stability and coupled thermal behavior remain open.

conditioned_calculations.expression: fact_lm2596_fb_vref_min_full_temp * (1 + fact_c861077_resistance * (1 - fact_c861077_tolerance / 100 - fact_c861077_tcr * temperature_delta_c / 1000000) / (fact_c110776_resistance * (1 + fact_c110776_tolerance / 100 + fact_c110776_tcr * temperature_delta_c / 1000000))) - input_requirement_v
conditioned_calculations.conditions: Requirement input 13 V from fixed-12 guarantee row; temperature excursions are explicit, and ripple/wiring losses are excluded.

rules.conditions: The current P-to-B interface is XFCN male JOUT1 to female J5: paired power pins 1/2, ATT 3, PDOK 4 and paired GND 5/6. Each contact nameplate is 3 A; paired contacts do not raise the 3 A PD contract. The unkeyed mechanical stack and actual temperature rise must be verified. Historical JST XH Board A does not directly mate.
rules.refusal: Do not promote contact nameplate arithmetic to installed capability without correct mating orientation, retained board support and full-load thermal measurement.

conditioned_calculations.conditions: This connector half has paired power contacts; the complete path is limited by the lower capacity of the two independently calculated halves. Derating0.8 is a project assumption.

rules.conditions: Board P uses 100 k source-to-gate and 150 k gate-to-VBEN, source-referenced C35 and a reset pull-down. Ideal asserted gate drive is -6 V at 15 V,-8 V at 20 V; the 32.4 V table point would imply -12.96 V steady. This is distinct from archived Board A 56 k/ground-referenced-cap evidence. NVM policy and real transient gate/source waveforms remain unknown.
rules.refusal: Do not authorize a20V policy or call the gate transient safe from steady divider math; require the exact NVM image/readbacks and measured gate/source behavior.

conditioned_calculations.conditions: Ideal asserted open-drain low; capacitor, parasitics and duration excluded.

rules.conditions: The retained manufacturer inverting-startup warning allows approximately 4.5 A for 2 ms or longer against a3A PD contract. The renewed negative bulk remains1410uF and stores about 0.141J at 14.145 V. Board P soft-start is not a demonstrated current limit; staged startup, actual adapter behavior and waveforms need qualification.
rules.refusal: Do not assume a3A charger starts the inverting stage because steady-state load is below its contract; capture the actual inrush and contract recovery.

conditioned_calculations.conditions: Typical4.5 A switch-limit warning, not a maximum guaranteed inrush bound.

rules.conditions: Existing PTC parts retain16/33/16 V ratings and 1.5/1.1/1.5 A room-temperature hold ratings for+12/+5/-12 budgets1.2/.5/.8 A. Hot hold-current, voltage drop, trip-time and reset behavior remain unverified. Regulator replacement does not improve PTC hot derating or establish attached-load overvoltage protection.
rules.refusal: Do not claim rated hot-enclosure output or fault coordination from room-temperature PTC nameplate margins.

conditioned_calculations.conditions: Room-temperature nameplate only; actual ambient and trip history matter.

rules.conditions: Board P routed geometry and current generated schematics have distinct evidence from incoming-part orientation, assembled boards, programmed NVM and measured behavior. Primary/retained-mirror trust is explicit; a clean netlist/ERC/DRC does not prove full-load performance. Historical four-order diagnosis remains history and does not qualify this renewal.
rules.refusal: Do not convert document, netlist or manufacturing checks into assembled, programmed or bench evidence; keep each unresolved downstream stage explicitly open.

rules.conditions: J10/J11 C4749189 replaces the old connector and guard. New pin groups1/2=-12 V,3..8=GND,9/10=+12 V,11/12=+5 V,13/14=CV,15/16=GATE. Doepfer pin1/red stripe convention is primary confirmed; imported numeric pad map, actual keyed cable continuity, finished-hole fit, wave solder compatibility and loaded contact temperature remain physical checks. Rail budgets are total board capacity shared by both outputs.
rules.refusal: Do not connect modules or certify polarity from a keyed housing alone; meter every rail through the actual cable and confirm solder process and loaded contact temperature before use.
